_note: Two Skyship subtypes that Hell-TCG never gave hero definitions to. Their art exists (4 pieces each) and the Crucible carried them as `provisional` rows with stats copied from a sibling template. Imported 2026-08-21 on the ruling that they are real Skyship subtypes.
_stats: PORTED STATS ONLY. The derived stats — accuracy, crit, luck, vision, movement, staminaMax, staminaRegen — are NOT copied from the Crucible: they come from the per-class table in build-heroes.mjs like every other hero, per the 2026-08-21 ruling that content/ owns the derived values. The Crucible's numbers for these two were themselves copied from an unrelated template and mean nothing.
_provisional: Both carry needsPricing. The ported stats came from a sibling template (sky-pirate and vigil-of-the-fallen respectively), not from anything authored for these characters. A sweep owns the numbers.
_gender: Read off the art 2026-08-21 — nothing in the source records it. All four Duelists are women, all four Wards are men.
